rationale: The agent followed policy throughout. It verified identity properly by matching full name and ZIP when the provided email did not match an account. It then used read-only tools to retrieve the user and order details before sharing order information, correctly identified the most expensive item and its price, and accurately explained that split payments aren’t supported. When the user requested cancellation, the agent clearly stated the intended change (cancel the pending order) and requested explicit confirmation of the reason before performing the write. It then executed the cancellation via the appropriate tool on the correct order, and the tool output confirms the status changed to cancelled and a refund was issued. The final message conveyed correct post-cancellation information. No unsupported claims, wrong actions, or writes without confirmation were observed.
